articles.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
articles.summary: Evaluating Microsoft Copilot at enterprise scale requires test data that captures the full complexity of real organizations, yet real enterprise data contains sensitive information that cannot be used for evaluation under any circumstances. The post From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence appeared first on Microsoft Research.

articles.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
articles.summary: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.

articles.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
articles.summary: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.
